items.title: 3 cash-producing stocks that concern us
items.summary: Generating cash is essential for any business, but not all cash-rich companies are great investments. Some produce plenty of cash but fail to allocate it effectively, leading to missed opportunities.

items.title: HII Q3 deep dive: margin expansion and contract wins drive upbeat outlook
items.summary: Aerospace and defense company Huntington Ingalls (NYSE:HII) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with sales up 10.8% year on year to $3.54 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.48 per share was 23.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Huntington Ingalls Industries (HII) Marks Record Q3 Revenue With ROMULUS Milestones
items.summary: Huntington Ingalls Industries (NYSE:HII) reported record Q3 revenues, highlighting its largest quarterly top line to date. The company reached key U.S. Navy milestones on ROMULUS unmanned surface vessel production, underscoring progress in autonomous maritime systems. Management linked the quarter's performance to expanding work on Navy contracts tied to advanced naval and robotics capabilities. items.title: 1 profitable stock on our watchlist and 2 facing headwinds
items.summary: Not all profitable companies are built to last - some rely on outdated models or unsustainable advantages. Just because a business is in the green today doesn’t mean it will thrive tomorrow.
